title: Menu Spec
description: Canonical intermediate artifact for a Joomla menu build. Produced by the menu-interpreter sub-agent (run_menu_interpretation) from a client menu document (PDF), reviewed/edited by a human, then built. See docs/kb/menu-spec-schema.md.

site.description: Active site URL this spec targets.

source.description: Source document filename the spec was derived from.

menus.description: Joomla menus keyed by menu name. 'mainmenu' = visible nav; 'hiddenmenu' = items that need a routable home but are not shown (common for redirect/external targets).

modules.description: Homepage/quicklink modules keyed by module key (e.g. toplinks, under_rotator).

grids.description: Grid pages. A grid page is a category_grid menu item plus a particle module; its member articles self-route and do NOT get their own menu items.

open_questions.description: Every guess or missing fact that needs human input before build. Required to be non-empty whenever any target/category is 'TBD'.

assumptions.description: Defaults the interpreter applied so they are reviewable rather than silent.

joomla_ids.description: Filled in during the Pre-Phase-4 confirmation and the Phase 4 build — created Joomla IDs (menus by menuType slug, categories, key menu items) keyed by name. Not produced by the interpreter.

category.description: Joomla category for article/grid types. Defaults to 'Page Content' for single_article when omitted.

target.description: Destination URL for external_url items. Use 'TBD' if unknown (and add an open_question).

menu_item.description: Title of a menu item (often on hiddenmenu) this quicklink points to, instead of a raw URL.

menu_ref.description: Title of the menu item that renders this grid.

members.description: Article titles listed under the grid in the source document. Created as articles in the grid's category during Phase 4 — never as menu items.
